name: KITRO
oneLiner: Swiss AI food waste tracker: a camera-and-scale device over the bin captures and classifies discarded food automatically, with dashboards for kitchen teams.
bestFor: Hotels, resorts, buffets and high-volume catering kitchens measuring food waste for cost and ESG reporting; less suited to quick-service restaurants.

updates.text: Became a preferred partner of Marriott International, supporting Marriott's goal to halve food waste.
Published a Hyatt EAME case study reporting over EUR 1.7M saved and a 31% cut in food waste across properties (vendor-reported).
Entered Portugal, starting with a flagship Pestana hotel in the Algarve.

features: In-bin device that photographs and weighs each disposal automatically, no manual logging
AI classification of waste by food type and edible vs inedible
Cost values per food category so waste is shown in money as well as weight
Dashboards and reports for chefs to adjust purchasing, production and buffet sizing
Sustainability and ESG reporting, relevant to EU food waste rules
Device rental on a monthly subscription, with a free assessment offered

pricing.text: Business plan from CHF 349 per month for a single kitchen; Enterprise plan is custom-priced based on operational complexity. Discounts depend on contract length, property size and number of units.

notes: Marriott preferred partnership is dated 2025 with no month. Dropped from current review: 'reduces avoidable food waste by up to 60%' and 'lifts food profit margin by up to 8%' (vendor claims; an independent ScienceDirect study of HORECA sites found 23-51% reductions: https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0956053X25001072), Four Seasons as a client (not confirmed), and 'onboarding in 2-4 weeks' (not confirmed). Company-reported totals (EUR 13M saved, 4.1M meals) in Hotel Interactive June 2026 are vendor figures. A third-party review says the multi-location central dashboard was not live at the time; confirm before claiming it. Customer base is hotels; weak fit for a QSR post (the current review already says so).
